findings.summary: _until_done retries forever with a fixed 1-minute pause: a permanent but retryable error (a bug, a Mongo validator WriteError) loops silently, and each round adds about 10 history events (about 15k a day), so a 3-day outage hits the 50k history limit and the workflow is terminated, which is the lockout BE-1 was meant to prevent. An unlimited activity RetryPolicy (maximum_attempts=0, capped interval) retries server-side with no history per attempt

_until_done re-raises only NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE, so an ActivityError with retry_state CANCEL_REQUESTED (the workflow is cancelled during the activity) is caught and retried, and cancellation is swallowed; re-raise when the cause is CancelledError or the state is CANCEL_REQUESTED

verify_documents (AGENT_STEP, 3 attempts) is still a bare execute_activity; it is a stub in 001, but once 002 makes it an LLM call, an exhausted retry fails the workflow in verifying with the case open (the BE-1 lockout)

Still open: retrying an already-applied action (same request_id) returns 409, not an idempotent 202; on a decided case, record_rejected_action now matches the applied record and writes nothing, but still answers 409
Still open: the daily-wake loop in under_review has no continue-as-new; at demo scale 1440 the history reaches 50k in about a week
Still open, now three copies: record_rejected_action adds a third inline copy of the ownership check (with worker _check_owned and scope.insert_one), alongside the duplicated to_bson
